question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

This query is no doubt a very correct and moral one, but it seems somewhat __cryptic__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mysterious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cryptic"** means having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure; something that is difficult to understand. (रहस्यमय)

 
 
• **Example: **The ancient manuscript was filled with cryptic symbols that no one could decipher.
 
 
 
• **"Mysterious" **refers to something that is difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify. (रहस्यमय)
 
 
• **Example: **The disappearance of the ship remains one of the most mysterious events in maritime history.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'cryptic' **is **'mysterious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Mysterious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clear **(स्पष्ट): Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret.

 
 
• **Example:** Her instructions were clear and easy to follow.
 
 
 
• **Obvious **(स्पष्ट): Easily perceived or understood; evident.
 
 
• **Example: **It was obvious that he was not telling the truth.
 
 
 
• **Common** (साधारण): Occurring, found, or done often; prevalent.
 
 
• **Example:** It is common to see people walking their dogs in the park.
